name: Nanaka
message: 「The romance of Orihime and Hikoboshi! Kind of makes me yearn for it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that look? Is it really that weird for me to say something girly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, though. Only once a year is a bit much, ya know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If he's a real man, he oughta swim across the Milky Way on his own power.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What? You're gonna muster up the courage and swim all the way across too? No way, no way, it's just not your style.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's this all of a sudden? This is for me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mustered up the courage? No, wait, I don't really get it, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's the big deal, I thought--it's a birthday present for me!」
